    Where did Sean Miller coach before Texas?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Before becoming the head coach at Texas in March 2025, Sean Miller was the head coach at Xavier (2022–2025), where he led the Musketeers to two NCAA Tournament appearances. Before his second stint at Xavier, he was the head coach at Arizona (2009–2021) and previously Xavier (2004–2009). 
    Sean Miller's Coaching History Prior to Texas: 
    • Xavier (Head Coach): 2022–2025
    • Arizona (Head Coach): 2009–2021
    • Xavier (Head Coach): 2004–2009
    • Xavier (Associate Head Coach): 2001–2004
    • NC State (Associate Head Coach): 1996–2001
    • Pittsburgh (Assistant Coach): 1995–1996
    • Miami (Ohio) (Assistant Coach): 1993–1995
    • Wisconsin (Assistant Coach): 1992–1993 
    Xavier University Athletics reports that Miller has a successful career with multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
